sn47.44:1.2: This is our instruction to you.
sn47.44:1.3: “And how, bhikkhus, is a bhikkhu mindful?
sn47.44:1.4: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.44:1.5: He dwells contemplating feelings in feelings …
sn47.44:1.7: phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.44:1.8: It is in this way, bhikkhus, that a bhikkhu is mindful.
sn47.44:1.10: This is our instruction to you.”
